kernel: Open CASCADE Technology 8.0.1, through cadquery-ocp 8.0.1.1.0 (OCP) from PyPI, on Python 3.11 — in a scratch directory, never a dependency of this repo
read: STEPControl_Reader with OpenCascade's standard healing; BRepCheck_Analyzer on the shape; its solids, shells and faces counted; its free edges (ShapeAnalysis_FreeBounds: edges of one face); its area and, for a solid, its volume by BRepGProp integrated to 1e-9 (the default reads a cylinder sheet 3.6e-4 off); every check the read and the transfer left, fails and warnings counted. The warnings are all 'Surface forced to be periodic', OpenCascade's own adjustment of a whole turn's B-spline.

planar-holed.what: a rectangle's planar surface, trimmed by a circle on it

revolved-sheet.what: a line turned whole about a parallel axis: a cylinder sheet, r 5 h 10

knit-filleted.what: the holed plate and a wall off its front edge, knitted, the join filleted r 4
